csv_scope_of_work: The California Department of Veterans Affairs (CalVet) is seeking Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) from qualified Architectural and Engineering Services firms to establish retainer agreements for as-needed services. This initiative aims to support various projects at CalVet facilities statewide, including Veterans Homes and Cemeteries. The selected firms will enter into a five-year agreement, with individual task orders issued for specific projects ranging from $5,000 to $1,000,000. CalVet's mission is to manage, maintain, and operate these facilities effectively. The scope of services includes but is not limited to: - Reviews for compliance with the Department of State Architect (ADA access compliance) and Health Care Access and Information (HCAI). - Conducting feasibility studies and constructability reviews. - Preparing budget packages and design documents including conceptual schemes, preliminary plans, and specifications. - Providing bidding support and construction administration/management. - Conducting field investigations, observing work, attending project meetings, and preparing studies/reports. - Performing shop drawing reviews and cost estimates. - Offering civil, mechanical, electrical, and geotechnical engineering services as needed. - Conducting hazardous material assessments and developing abatement design plans/specifications if required. Services will be provided at various CalVet facilities throughout the State of California including locations such as Sacramento (CalVet Headquarters), Barstow, Chula Vista, Fresno, Lancaster, Redding, Ventura, West Los Angeles, Yountville, Seaside (California Central Coast Veterans Cemetery), and Igo (Northern California Veterans Cemetery).
